chunks: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, saying: Abu Sa'id al-Adamy narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hussein ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur,
he said: I saw Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) have phlebotomy performed on him on a Wednesday after the afternoon prayer.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet's son perform on Wednesday afternoon according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* highlights the practical wisdom of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) by documenting his adherence to the Sunnah of cupping (hijama) on Wednesdays, a day traditionally associated with healing and spiritual purification in Shia tradition. It underscores the integration of prophetic medical practices with daily life, affirming the Imam’s role as both a spiritual guide and a model of physical well-being. The specific timing—after afternoon prayers—further emphasizes the balance between devotion and self-care in the Imam’s routine.
